The '''''Ashtan Tor''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that operated during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the freighter was raided by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] while hauling a cargo of the narcotic [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Some of the ryll that had been carried aboard the freighter was subsequently obtained by the drug dealer [[Kelkan D'vrosh]], on the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
